title: End Update Needed!
description: The Minecraft End Update is  a Thing of The Past.  Fortunately With This Neoforge Mod You Can Bring it into Existence.
body:
Welcome to the ultimate End expansion. This mod transforms the barren End dimension into a vibrant, challenging, and rewarding ecosystem filled with unique content.
New Biomes: Explore distinct alien environments like the Chorus Forest and Void Barrens.
Unique Blocks and Items: Mine rare Enderite Ore to craft powerful endgame tier tools and armor.
Dangerous Mobs: Encounter passive, neutral, and hostile void creatures that inhabit the outer islands.Compatibility: Designed to blend seamlessly with vanilla mechanics while offering a fresh endgame challenge. (Optional : Install Sodium and Lithium for better performance)
